usage.config: 账号/证书由原Go冷层控制，V4全配置映射尚未逐项复核
usage.gui: WinForms可编辑部分连接字段；多账号并行产品验证缺失

verification.scope: 原生 Normal/off：原Go真实TLS鉴权与双向数据；此结果仅旧W源码，不是盘点HEAD的重新测试
原Go TLS与Rust真实raw/TUN：多真实Go TLS lane的特定Game场景（旧L源码，非本次审阅SHA）
不同账户同时多客户端真实隔离
所有认证反面用例及长期凭据轮换

limitations: 建连通路正向≠多租户隔离全部场景已验；Rust V4不支持和旧Go V3数据面互通保证。
本卡审阅产品SOURCE为 fcf33b14489b46d37aa29d5d9304d1e5a3fe010b；verification已注明的旧Action/旧SHA不代表本次HEAD重测，未列PASS的平台和模式保持未验证。
PLAN028仅规划补齐账号输入简化、单端口同账号多设备/自动地址/每会话独立配置；不改变本卡现有源码与资格。
PLAN028后续约定：client只提交外层MTU意图，server结合本地方向限制收窄；内层自动派生，不要求双端手填，不覆盖其他client全局TUN。本次仅方案同步。

PLAN028 PLANNED: changed underlay triggers fresh TLS/account authentication and authenticated device/session+lease continuation, allowing a new source IP without waiting for old-lane dead. Same username/source IP/public install ID alone cannot take over another session; sibling same-account devices and their config/TUN must remain unaffected. New lane keys/generation and owned old-resource cleanup are required; server restart may lose the lease, so inner TCP continuity is conditional. Default outer MTU1460 is preserved. No new steady wire fields; native and Android roaming are not qualified by this plan.
